items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 102:1
items.html: Behold, the externality of the Rechem, in the whole of AVI and Yeshsut, which is the Rosh of the first Tevuna, where the Mochin of ZA emerge from the coupling of AVI, is called the Mem of Tzelem. At the birth of ZA it diminished to the discernment of VAK, called crouching, and its GAR became HGT, as is known. Therefore these HGT also include GAR within them, since they came from the discernment of GAR — for during the pregnancy it was in the discernment of GAR, and also afterward, at the Gadlut of ZA, it is destined to return to the discernment of GAR. It is therefore discerned as the first six Sefirot of this Tevuna, namely KHB HGT up to the Chazeh. And it is discerned as Avir [air], meaning the light of Ruach, which is the light of Hassadim. There are two reasons for this: either from the time of Katnut, when it descended to the discernment of VAK, which is the light of Ruach; or from the time of Gadlut, when the illumination of Hochma is still withheld from them, since they are the discernment of AVI Ilain, which are from the Chazeh and above (as above, in Answer 176), being in covered Hassadim, and are therefore called by the name Avir even then. And they are also called by the name Hochma, since at the time of Gadlut they are destined to become the discernment of AVI Ilain, which are called Hochma. For this reason it is called the Yud of HaVaYaH, since AVI Ilain are the discernment of the Yud of HaVaYaH, as is known, for Aba is the Yud, and Upper Ima is the filling of Vav-Dalet in the filling of Yud. And it is also called Tzelem, since it is the root in which the lower letters are included, and therefore the Lamed and the Tzadi too are included in the Mem. (Item 127).
